say:1:1523622001:0.text: This morning, I got a distress call from the army—their horses suddenly went berserk for no apparent reason.

say:2:1523622002:1.text: They urged me to reach out to the Arcane Council for help.
say:2:1523622002:1.source_cn: 他们想让我去找魔法师协会，用魔法看看这些马到底出了什么问题。

say:5:1523623004:1.text: We rode them to Windchoke Fen once to collect abandoned weapons.
say:5:1523623004:1.source_cn: 这些马跟着队伍去过一次风沼战场，去回收遗落在战场的武器。

say:6:1523623005:1.text: Now that you mention it… they started acting strange after that trip.

say:1:1523624002:1.text: You glance at their legs as they stomp the ground impatiently. Their hooves are spotless and well-polished. Yan has been taking good care of them, so they aren't in a bad mood.
